integrity.proof_basis: Explicit killed-resolvent cofactors, rational sign inequalities, exact Sturm root count; a finite rational checker supplements the proof.

scientific_limitations: The bias interval is sufficient and is not asserted to be maximal.
For every bias in the range at least two strict extrema are proved; exactly two are certified at epsilon=1/20.
The thirteen-state example is not claimed state-size minimal.
Historical-priority completeness and independent validation are not claimed.
title: Two transition biases suffice for a double reset-rate reversal in gambler's ruin
